newsitem.title: USA: Techniclone says test results are positive.
newsitem.headline: Techniclone says test results are positive.

text.p: Techniclone Corp on Monday said a limited study of its antibody technology for treating advanced brain cancer obtained disease-free remission for up to 15 months versus expected survival of less than six months.

The testing of Techniclone's Tumor Necrosis Therapy (TNT) was conducted in Shanghai, China, via a collaboration of the Six People's Hospital, the Neurological Institute and the University of Southern California, Techniclone said.
Eight patients were treated with I-131 (Iodine-131) radiolabeled TNT by injection into the spinal column, the blood stream or directly into the tumor.

Seven patients achieved complete remission with disease-free periods ranging from 12 to 15 months, with all remaining in remission according to updated data. The eighth patient died to causes not related to treatment.

"This study provides validation for the TNT approach," said Alan Epstein, professor of pathology at the University of Southern California Medical Center and director of scientific affairs for Techniclone.
The disease status for each patient was confirmed by pathologic analysis at USC, Techniclone said.
